request: Show how the spending on each of our two accounts adds up over the year.

plan.title: Each account added up over 2025
plan.question: spending of 2025 added up from January onwards inside each account, the running total after each month per account, one row per month and account, columns month as 'YYYY-MM', account and cumulative_eur

sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, account AS account, SUM(-amount) AS spent
  FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0
  GROUP BY month, account
)
SELECT month, account,
       ROUND(SUM(spent) OVER (PARTITION BY account ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month, account

sql:
WITH spending AS (
  SELECT '2025-Q' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS quarter, COALESCE(category, 'Needs review') AS topic, -amount AS spent
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0 AND account = 'Sparkasse Stuttgart Gemeinschaftskonto'
),
largest AS (
  SELECT topic FROM spending GROUP BY topic ORDER BY SUM(spent) DESC, topic LIMIT 4
)
SELECT quarter, topic, ROUND(SUM(spent), 2) AS total_eur
FROM spending WHERE topic IN (SELECT topic FROM largest)
GROUP BY quarter, topic
ORDER BY quarter, topic
